email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineer/Civil Designer role in your Tamworth engineering team, advertised on SEEK, and sending my resume and cover letter to this address as your careers page asks. The ad's line about a graduate ready for broader project exposure describes where I am.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I reviewed drawings, checked the work against them, ran inspections and kept site records, including on subdivision finishing works.

I haven't worked in an Australian design office yet, so my design software experience is AutoCAD and Civil 3D from the diploma. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Tamworth.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I'm applying for the Civil Engineer/Civil Designer role in your Tamworth engineering team, advertised on SEEK. The ad says you would also consider a graduate civil engineer ready for broader project exposure, and that describes where I am: a civil engineering degree, an Australian design diploma and a year on site, looking for a team where I can work across roads, subdivisions and drainage with senior engineers to learn from. Your engineering page lists rail, local government and development projects, which is the range I want.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities, options analyses and risk registers. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered hydraulics, surveying, structural principles and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and progress records. It gave me a builder's view of the drawings I would now be producing.

I have not worked in an Australian design office yet, so my design software experience is AutoCAD and Civil 3D from the diploma. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Tamworth.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the team's projects and where a graduate would start.
